All Classes and Interfaces

Class
Description
CashierView
Order entry: customize panel on the left, menu tabs in the middle, current order on the right.
CustomerView
Customer-facing display for the register, shown in its own window.
CustomerView.Mode
Which screen is showing.
Database
Opens connections using the settings in db.properties (see db.properties.example).
DataStore
Everything the screens need from the database.
Employee
A row of the employee table: someone who can log in to the POS.
EmployeesPane
Manager employee list.
HourlySales
One hour of the X-report.
InventoryItem
One row of inventory_item: an ingredient, topping or supply stocked for one drink.
InventoryPane
Manager inventory screen.
InventoryUsage
How much of one inventory item was used in a date window, for the Inventory Usage report.
InventoryUsagePane
Inventory Usage report: how much of each inventory item was used between two dates.
ItemSales
One menu item's sales in a date range, for the Sales Report.
JdbcDataStore
DataStore backed by squad_21_db.
JdbcDataStore.SqlWork<T>
Some SQL to run on an open connection; used with JdbcDataStore.query(java.lang.String, data.JdbcDataStore.SqlWork<T>).
LoginView
Login screen: employee ID and PIN.
Main
Starts the Sharetea POS.
ManagerView
Manager tools, one tab per page.
MenuItem
One drink or snack on the menu.
MenuPane
Manager menu editor.
MockDataStore
In-memory sample data so the GUI runs without the database.
MockDataStore.Recipe
One sale of menuName uses servings of the inventory row inventoryId (inventory_item.servings_used).
MockDataStore.Sale
One sample sale, like a row of the sales table.
MockDataStore.SaleLine
One line of a sample sale, like a row of order_line_items.
OrderLine
One item in the current order, with its customizations.
PaymentDialog
Tip and payment method for the current order.
PaymentResult
What the cashier entered in the payment dialog for one order.
Pricing
Prices and rounding rules shared by the register, the payment dialog and the reports.
ReportRange
Validated inclusive dates for a report, shared by JDBC and sample data.
RestockOrder
A row of restock_order: an order for more of one inventory item, Pending until it is received.
RestockReportPane
Restock Report: every inventory row whose on-hand stock is under its minimum (the same rule that marks a row LOW in the Inventory tab).
RestocksPane
Manager list of restock orders, newest first.
SalesDashboardPane
Manager sales dashboard: total sales, orders, average ticket and top item for a date range and category, with charts of units sold by item and sales per day.
SalesReportPane
Sales by menu item for inclusive dates, with historical revenue and no refunds.
SalesSummary
Results for the sales dashboard.
Screen
One window size shared by every screen.
Topping
A topping the cashier can add to a drink, such as Tapioca Pearls.
Ui
Small helpers shared by the screens.
XReportPane
X-report: today's sales hour by hour, with a Total row.
